cohort: 180 pregnant women presenting to the emergency department of an obstetrics and gynecology department between April 1 and June 30, 2020, divided into two groups: 90 COVID-19 positive and 90 COVID-19 negative.
finding: There were no significant differences between COVID-19 positive and negative pregnant women in terms of age, parity, gestational age, comorbidities, mode of delivery, maternal complications, neonatal Apgar scores, or birth weight.
